intents.name: CREATE_PRODUCT
intents.description: Artisan starts describing a new handicraft or handloom item
examples: यह एक लकड़ी का खिलौना है
I want to add a silk saree

intents.name: UPDATE_PRODUCT
intents.description: Artisan provides additional attributes or missing details for the product

intents.name: CORRECT_INFORMATION
intents.description: Artisan corrects a previously stated attribute or value
examples: No, it is cotton not silk

intents.name: SET_PRICE
intents.description: Artisan specifically states or updates the price of the item

intents.name: SET_QUANTITY
intents.description: Artisan specifies the available quantity or stock count

intents.name: CONFIRM
intents.description: Artisan affirms or accepts a question or summary

intents.name: REJECT
intents.description: Artisan declines or rejects a question or operation

intents.name: CHECK_PRODUCT
intents.description: Artisan inquires about the current state or details of their draft
examples: What have I entered so far?

intents.name: PUBLISH_PRODUCT
intents.description: Artisan is satisfied and wants to finalize and publish the product to catalog
